तिमिध्वज

TIMIDHVAJA . A demon who was ruling in the state of Vaijayantapura. He was called śambara also. This demon once attacked Devaloka. indra was not able to kill him. So he sought the help of Dasaratha. daśaratha went and fought against the demons. daśaratha was made to faint in the battlefield by the magic of timidhvaja and kaikeyī who was there then, took him away and gave him all first aid. Pleased at this daśaratha promised two boons for her and it was these boons that kaikeyī demanded of daśaratha on the advice of mantharā at the time of the coronation of śrī rāma. (sarga 9, ayodhyā Kāṇḍa, vālmīki rāmāyaṇa).

तिमिंगिल

TIMIṄGILA . A King. sahadeva defeated this King during his victory campaign in the south. (Śloka 69, Chapter 31, Sabhā Parva).
